title: Selected
description: A selection of single analogue photographs by Bart Mulder from different trips: mountains, beaches and quiet interiors, all shot on film.

images.alt: A mountain river flowing through a forested valley with tall trees on either side, and mountains with clouds in the background.
Yellow house with a tiled red roof nestled among lush greenery, with mountains and the ocean in the background.
A house with a tiled roof, two chimneys, and a front door, surrounded by trees, with mountains in the background.
Beach houses with solar panels on roofs, ocean, sunset sky with clouds and birds.
Sunset at the beach with a wooden house, blue beach cabanas, a small pier, and seagulls near the water.
Yellow lifeguard tower with a ramp on a sandy beach near the ocean, under a clear blue sky.
A mountain cabin outdoor patio with two turquoise chairs, a small round stone table, potted flowers, and lush greenery with forested mountains in the background.
Empty restaurant with tables and chairs, sunlight casting shadows, through large windows.
